title: Rental Contract Term, Waiting Periods and Upgrade Availability
content:
Term and waiting-period figures of Rental Property Service Contracts. The term length is in calendar months; the waiting period is the number of calendar days after purchase before coverage begins; the upgrade waiting period is the number of calendar days after a mid-term upgrade before added items or higher limits are covered; the last column states whether the tier can be upgraded during a term.

| Tier | Term length | Waiting period after purchase | Waiting period after a mid-term upgrade | Mid-term upgrade available |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance | 12 months | 30 days | 30 days | yes |
| Bridgewell Rental Systems | 12 months | 30 days | 30 days | yes |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | 12 months | 30 days | 30 days | yes |
| Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus | 12 months | 30 days | 30 days | no |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | 12 months | 30 days | 30 days | yes |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus | 12 months | 30 days | 30 days | no |

The two Plus tiers are the tiers on which no mid-term upgrade is available; a contract on any of the other four tiers can be upgraded during a term.
